say:1:1130954001:1.text: I... I'm not anymore! I'll never go back to that camp!
say:1:1130954001:1.source_cn: 我……我现在不是了！我不回营地！！

say:2:1130954002:1.text: Huh? You don't look like a Claw or an Alkali settler...
say:2:1130954002:1.source_cn: 咦……？你看起来不像是流沙之爪，也不像是咸水镇上的人……
say:2:1130954002:1.male: Huh? You don't look like a Claw or an Alkali settler...
say:2:1130954002:1.female: Huh? You don't look like a Claw or an Alkali settler...

say:3:1130954003:1.text: You're not a bounty hunter, are you?! Please don't take me in!
say:3:1130954003:1.source_cn: 你、你该不会是赏金猎人吧？！哇啊！不要把我抓回去领赏啊！！
say:3:1130954003:1.male: You're not a bounty hunter, are you?! Please don't take me in!
say:3:1130954003:1.female: You're not a bounty hunter, are you?! Please don't take me in!

say:4:1130954004:1.text: I was just a cook, I never hurt anyone! Please let me go!
say:4:1130954004:1.source_cn: 我一直在厨房里打下手，完全没做过坏事！求求你放过我吧！
say:4:1130954004:1.male: I was just a cook, I never hurt anyone! Please let me go!
say:4:1130954004:1.female: I was just a cook, I never hurt anyone! Please let me go!
